satirlar.metin: Want to keep more of your money every month? Here are five habits that can help. Let's count down!
Number five: the 24-hour rule. Wait a day before a non-essential purchase, and many impulse buys fade away.
Number four: cancel subscriptions you never use. Small monthly fees add up over a year.
Number three: cook at home more often. Planning meals can often cost less than takeout.
Number two: automate your savings. Move a small amount on payday before you can spend it.
And number one: track your spending! You can't fix a leak you can't see.
Which habit would you start first? Tell us in the comments and subscribe for more!
